item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop intervention probes for whether NextItNet uses coherent recent intent or stale interactions. Compare score and rank changes after removing recent versus older history, shuffling order, and truncating context; connect effects to dilated convolution receptive fields. Check causal masking and final-nonpadding readout before interpreting results. Use training-history prefixes and matched perturbations, since perturbations alone do not establish users’ true intent.","query":"NextItNet sequential recommendation diagnostic probes history perturbation recency order sensitivity dilated convolution receptive field causal masking"},{"reason":"Translate qualitative complaints into auditable recommendation-level evidence: specific recent-interest matches, potential duplicates, useful complements, and unresolved compatibility. Research title/description-grounded annotation with explicit unknown and insufficient-evidence labels, then calibrate automated proxies against the twenty users’ feedback. Do not infer ownership, replacement needs, compatibility, or unobserved traits from interaction history alone.","query":"recommendation explanation evaluation user feedback annotation duplicate complementary products compatibility uncertainty evidence grounded item titles descriptions"},{"reason":"Establish whether diagnostics identify ranking failures and predict useful changes to a single trained NextItNet model. Seek scale-invariant rank measures, popularity- and history-length-conditioned error rates, bootstrap uncertainty, and controlled training ablations. Distinguish training-prefix diagnostics, sampled-candidate validation HR@10, and full-catalog feedback; preserve the pinned evaluator and avoid repeated diagnostic selection on the same validation users.","query":"sequential recommender diagnostic metric validation sampled negatives full catalog ranking popularity bias bootstrap uncertainty controlled ablation"}]}
